data.name: Sahbah
data.long_meaning: Sahbah is an Islamic name for both boys and girls, derived from the Arabic word 'sahib', which means 'companion'. In the Islamic tradition, Sahbah refers to the close companions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be a devoted companion, guided by faith and virtue.
data.numerology_meaning: A nurturing and caring personality, with a strong sense of responsibility and a desire to help others
